recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: oracle queries humming in quantum circuits
humility circulating among smart minds online
database indexes racing faster than their namesakes
clear autumn night over san francisco, eleven degrees
sunrise at seven-seventeen, sunset creeping toward six-thirty

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Sort glowing query tokens into the correct semantic lane before the index rebuilds and wipes your clusters.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to shift lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each correct sort blooms a micro-cluster on screen — watch the index fill up in one minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: more token types appear, lanes narrow, rebuild timer shrinks
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe on dark terminal green

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap when the oracle waveform collapses to the right answer before superposition fades into noise.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: each correct collapse adds a harmonic layer to an ambient hum that builds toward resolution
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: waveforms overlap, false peaks appear, collapse window narrows
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: phosphor oscilloscope traces on black glass

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw fog paths through cold autumn air pockets to carry warmth between distant streetlamps before the wind erases them.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to trace a continuous path
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: connected lamps pulse in sequence like a circuit completing — chain five for a full block glow
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: wind gusts erase partial paths, lamps spawn farther apart, fog density drops
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor ink wash — burnt orange and slate blue

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick agent capsules between parallel task lanes; only the lane matching the task color ships before the sunrise bar drains.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each successful shipment leaves a tiny sunrise streak across the sky progress bar
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more lanes open, decoy colors appear, sunrise bar drains faster each round
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout diorama with golden-hour gradients
